_comment: EXAMPLE per-plan completion contract. Copy to active-contract.json (drop the .example) to arm the Stop hook for a run; delete it when the run ends. The Stop hook only reads active-contract.json, so this .example file is inert.

deliverables.check: uv run pytest -> exit 0, 0 failures, 0 errors
git diff --name-only base..HEAD -- tests/ shows no edits to pre-existing v0.1 test files
Lens protocol + scorer registry exist in interest/; existing semantic scorers registered as the first lens
ProfileRankingService dispatches by lens name; v0.1 single-pipeline behavior preserved by default
SearchResult/ProfileSearchResult carry additive optional lens_scores + per_lens_explanations; legacy score/ranking_explanation unchanged
new tests assert v0.1 behavior is preserved through the dispatcher

hard_constraints: do NOT rewrite the v0.1 ranking core (ADR-0001 coexistence: generalize the profile primitive, don't replace)
fusion is never the default; per-lens results are a dict, not an averaged value
the 'semantic' lens label does NOT imply dense embeddings — TF-IDF/lexical carries forward
no merge to main without human approval
halt_conditions: any irreversible/outward-facing action (merge, tag, publish, v0.3, cross-repo)
ambiguity in the lens-abstraction shape that needs a design decision
